hooks.command: node -e "let d='';process.stdin.on('data',c=>d+=c);process.stdin.on('end',()=>{try{const i=JSON.parse(d);const cmd=(i.tool_input&&i.tool_input.command)||'';if(cmd.indexOf('read-replica/run.sh')!==-1){process.stdout.write(JSON.stringify({hookSpecificOutput:{hookEventName:'PreToolUse',permissionDecision:'allow',permissionDecisionReason:'Sanctioned read-replica skill (reads .env.production internally, no secret leak)'}}))}}catch(e){}})"

PreToolUse.matcher: tool == "Bash" && tool_input.command matches "^(docker|make|pnpm dev|npm run dev|yarn dev|bun run dev)"

hooks.command: node -e "if(!process.env.TMUX){console.error('[Hook] BLOCKED: docker/make must run in tmux for log access');console.error('[Hook] Use: tmux new-session -d -s dev \"<command>\"');console.error('[Hook] Then: tmux attach -t dev');process.exit(1)}else{let d='';process.stdin.on('data',c=>d+=c);process.stdin.on('end',()=>console.log(d))}"

find "$PROJECT_DIR" -name 'CLAUDE.md' -mtime +14 2>/dev/null | while read f; do days=$(( ( $(date +%s) - $(stat -f %m "$f") ) / 86400 )); echo "[Hook] STALE (${days}d): $f"; done
"$HOME/.config/tmux/claude-window-state.sh" idle

if [ -n "$TMUX" ]; then tmux set-window-option -t "$TMUX_PANE" automatic-rename on; tmux set-option -pu -t "$TMUX_PANE" @claude-name; tmux set-option -pu -t "$TMUX_PANE" @claude-title; tmux set-option -pu -t "$TMUX_PANE" @claude-state; fi

statusLine.command: input=$(cat); model=$(echo "$input" | jq -r '.model.display_name'); dir=$(basename "$(echo "$input" | jq -r '.workspace.current_dir')"); remaining=$(echo "$input" | jq -r '.context_window.remaining_percentage // empty'); branch=$(cd "$(echo "$input" | jq -r '.workspace.current_dir')" 2>/dev/null && git -c core.fileMode=false rev-parse --abbrev-ref HEAD 2>/dev/null || echo ''); effort=$(echo "$input" | jq -r '.effort.level // empty'); printf "\033[96m%s\033[0m \033[90m|\033[0m \033[95m%s\033[0m" "$model" "$dir"; [ -n "$branch" ] && printf " \033[90m|\033[0m \033[93m%s\033[0m" "$branch"; [ -n "$effort" ] && printf " \033[90m|\033[0m \033[36meffort: %s\033[0m" "$effort"; if [ -n "$remaining" ]; then r=$(printf "%.0f" "$remaining"); if [ "$r" -gt 50 ]; then c="\033[92m"; elif [ "$r" -gt 25 ]; then c="\033[93m"; else c="\033[91m"; fi; printf " \033[90m|\033[0m ${c}ctx: %s%%\033[0m" "$r"; fi; echo
